messages.subject: Re: Extract Latent Class Probabilities
parts:
Hi Ray,

I had an incomplete draft of this from a long time ago. I just dusted this off and finished it. If you install the development branch of MplusAutomation, you'll see that readModels now has $parameters$probability.scale that contains this information.

Instructions for installing the dev version are here: https://github.com/michaelhallquist/MplusAutomation.

Best,
Michael
